plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Lets AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor...) read text on your screen and translate it through oxelis-host.exe. Off unless this plugin is installed and enabled. Pictures of the screen need 'screenshot' in allowed tools.
plugins.name: MCP server (AI assistants)

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: A panel next to the selection: its size, and how many lines, words and characters were recognised.
plugins.name: Selection stats

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Two buttons for recognised text: copy it as one paragraph, copy it without blank lines. Also trims trailing spaces of every recognised line.
plugins.name: Text tools

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Amber frame and a dark warm toolbar; the toolbar prefers to sit above the selection.
plugins.name: Amber theme

plugins.author: Oxelis

credits.license: not stated in the README; read the license on the model page before use
credits.name: Hy-MT2

credits.license: cite when you use the model
credits.name: Hy-MT2: A Family of Fast, Efficient and Powerful Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild

plugins.description: Translation with Tencent Hunyuan's Hy-MT2 model, served on this machine by llama.cpp (llama-server), vLLM or Ollama. Oxelis does not ship or install the model: you download it from its owner and run the server yourself. The address you enter is the only host this plugin can reach.
plugins.name: Hy-MT2 (local model server)

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Translation with a LibreTranslate server (Argos models) that you run yourself, for example `libretranslate` or the Docker image on http://localhost:5000. Nothing leaves your machine. The address you enter is the only host this plugin can reach.
plugins.name: LibreTranslate (offline, on this machine)

plugins.author: Oxelis
plugins.description: Offline translation with MTranServer (https://github.com/xxnuo/MTranServer, Bergamot/Firefox Translations models) running on this machine, default http://localhost:8989. Nothing leaves your machine. The address you enter is the only host this plugin can reach.
plugins.name: MTranServer (offline, on this machine)

plugins.author: Oxelis

credits.license: a web service, subject to MyMemory's terms
credits.name: MyMemory

plugins.description: Free translation memory with a documented public API. No key; about 5000 characters a day per address. Quality is below the big engines.
plugins.name: MyMemory

plugins.author: Oxelis

credits.license: the API format is used by many servers; the server you enter has its own terms
credits.name: OpenAI API (chat completions format)

plugins.description: Translation with any large language model behind an OpenAI-compatible chat API: OpenAI, DeepSeek, a model on this machine (Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1, no key needed, works offline). The address you enter is the only host this plugin can reach.
plugins.name: LLM (OpenAI-compatible)
